Name: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018)
Description: The original Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC-1:2018), published by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), across 5 Main Domains, 29 Subdomains, and 114 Cybersecurity Controls. NCA superseded this version with ECC-2:2024 (4 Domains, 28 Subdomains — Domain 5, Industrial Control Systems, was removed in that update). This file is kept as a distinct, separately-selectable framework for organizations still tracking against the original 2018 baseline.

Requirements.Name: 1-1-1 Cybersecurity Strategy Definition & Approval
Requirements.Description: A cybersecurity strategy must be defined, documented and approved. It must be supported by the head of the organization or his/her delegate (Authorizing Official). The strategy goals must be in-line with related laws and regulations.

Requirements.Name: 1-1-2 Cybersecurity Strategy Roadmap Execution
Requirements.Description: A roadmap must be executed to implement the cybersecurity strategy across all organizational cloud and digital environments.

Requirements.Name: 1-1-3 Periodic Review of Cybersecurity Strategy
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity strategy must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals or upon changes to related laws and regulations.

Requirements.Name: 1-2-1 Dedicated Independent Cybersecurity Function
Requirements.Description: A dedicated cybersecurity function (e.g. division, department) must be established within the organization, independent from IT/ICT functions, reporting directly to the head of the organization.

Requirements.Name: 1-2-2 CISO and Critical Security Staff National Hiring
Requirements.Description: The position of cybersecurity function head (CISO), and related supervisory and critical positions within the function, must be filled with full-time and experienced Saudi cybersecurity professionals.

Requirements.Name: 1-2-3 Cybersecurity Steering Committee
Requirements.Description: A cybersecurity steering committee must be established by the Authorizing Official to ensure the support and implementation of cybersecurity programs and initiatives.

Requirements.Name: 1-3-1 Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures Documentation
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be defined and documented by the cybersecurity function, approved by the Authorizing Official, and disseminated to relevant parties.

Requirements.Name: 1-3-2 Cybersecurity Policies Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity function must ensure that the approved cybersecurity policies and procedures are actively implemented and enforced.

Requirements.Name: 1-3-3 Technical Security Standards Baseline
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be supported by technical security standards (e.g. operating systems, databases, and firewall technical security standards).

Requirements.Name: 1-3-4 Periodic Review of Policies and Procedures
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity policies and procedures must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals or upon regulatory updates. Changes must be approved and documented.

Requirements.Name: 1-4-1 Roles and Responsibilities Structure & Segregation
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity organizational structure and related roles and responsibilities must be defined, documented, approved, and assigned without conflict of interest.

Requirements.Name: 1-4-2 Periodic Review of Roles and Responsibilities
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals or regulatory updates.

Requirements.Name: 1-5-1 Cybersecurity Risk Management Methodology
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures must be defined, documented, and approved as per confidentiality, integrity, and availability considerations.

Requirements.Name: 1-5-2 Risk Management Procedures Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures must be implemented by the cybersecurity function.

Requirements.Name: 1-5-3 Mandatory Risk Assessments on Projects & Infrastructure Changes
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity risk assessments must be conducted at early project stages, before major infrastructure changes, when procuring 3rd party services, and before go-live.

Requirements.Name: 1-5-4 Periodic Review of Risk Management Methodology
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity risk management methodology and procedures must be reviewed periodically according to planned intervals.

Requirements.Name: 1-6-1 Cybersecurity in Project & Change Management Lifecycle
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements must be included in project and asset change management methodology and procedures to manage risks throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements.Name: 1-6-2 Project Vulnerability Assessment, Configuration Review & Hardening
Requirements.Description: Conduct vulnerability assessment, remediation, secure configuration, hardening, and patching before changes or going live for technology projects.

Requirements.Name: 1-6-3 Secure Application Development & Secure Coding Standards
Requirements.Description: Apply secure coding standards, trusted software libraries, compliance testing, secure component integration, and configuration reviews before software goes live.

Requirements.Name: 1-6-4 Periodic Review of Project Management Cybersecurity
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements in project management must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 1-7-1 Compliance with National Cybersecurity Laws & Regulations
Requirements.Description: The organization must comply with related national cybersecurity laws, regulations, and NCA regulatory frameworks.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-7 Compliance with Standards, Laws and Regulations

Requirements.Name: 1-7-2 Compliance with Approved International Agreements
Requirements.Description: The organization must comply with any nationally-approved international agreements and commitments related to cybersecurity.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-7 Compliance with Standards, Laws and Regulations

Requirements.Name: 1-8-1 Periodic Internal Cybersecurity Reviews
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity reviews must be conducted periodically by the internal cybersecurity function to assess compliance with cybersecurity controls.

Requirements.Name: 1-8-2 Independent Cybersecurity Audits (GAAS)
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity audits must be conducted by independent parties outside the cybersecurity function (e.g. Internal Audit) as per Generally Accepted Auditing Standards (GAAS).

Requirements.Name: 1-8-3 Audit Results Reporting to Steering Committee & Authorizing Official
Requirements.Description: Results from cybersecurity audits must be presented to the steering committee and Authorizing Official, including scope, observations, recommendations, and remediation plans.

Requirements.Name: 1-9-1 Personnel Cybersecurity Requirements Definition
Requirements.Description: Personnel cybersecurity requirements (prior to employment, during employment, and after termination/separation) must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 1-9-2 Personnel Cybersecurity Requirements Implementation
Requirements.Description: The personnel cybersecurity requirements must be actively implemented across HR onboarding, employment, and exit operations.

Requirements.Name: 1-9-3 Pre-Employment Screening, Vetting & NDA Clauses
Requirements.Description: Inclusion of cybersecurity responsibilities and non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) in employment contracts, and screening/vetting candidates for critical/privileged positions.

Requirements.Name: 1-9-4 Employment Cybersecurity Awareness & Compliance
Requirements.Description: Provide cybersecurity awareness during onboarding and employment, and ensure compliance with organizational cybersecurity policies.

Requirements.Name: 1-9-5 Immediate Access Revocation Upon Termination
Requirements.Description: Personnel access to information and technology assets must be reviewed and removed immediately upon termination or separation.

Requirements.Name: 1-9-6 Periodic Review of HR Cybersecurity Requirements
Requirements.Description: Personnel cybersecurity requirements must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 1-10-1 Cybersecurity Awareness Program Development
Requirements.Description: A cybersecurity awareness program must be developed and approved, conducted periodically through multiple channels to strengthen cyber threat culture.

Requirements.Name: 1-10-2 Cybersecurity Awareness Program Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity awareness program must be implemented across all organizational departments.

Requirements.Name: 1-10-3 Phishing, Mobile, Web & Social Media Security Awareness
Requirements.Description: Awareness topics must cover email handling/phishing, mobile devices/storage media, secure browsing, and secure use of social media.

Requirements.Name: 1-10-4 Specialized Cybersecurity Training for Technical Staff & Executives
Requirements.Description: Tailored training and skillsets must be provided for cybersecurity personnel, developers, IT operations staff, and executive/supervisory leaders.

Requirements.Name: 1-10-5 Periodic Review of Awareness & Training Program
Requirements.Description: The implementation of the cybersecurity awareness program must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-1 Asset Management Policy Definition & Approval
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for managing information and technology assets must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-2 Asset Management Implementation & Inventory
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for managing information and technology assets must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-3 Acceptable Use Policy Definition
Requirements.Description: Acceptable use policy of information and technology assets must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-4 Acceptable Use Policy Enforcement
Requirements.Description: Acceptable use policy of information and technology assets must be implemented and enforced.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-5 Information Asset Classification & Labeling
Requirements.Description: Information and technology assets must be classified, labeled, and handled as per related laws and regulatory requirements.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-6 Periodic Review of Asset Management Requirements
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for managing information and technology assets must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-1 Identity and Access Management Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for identity and access management must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-2 Identity and Access Management Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for identity and access management must be implemented across all systems.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-3 Authentication, MFA, Least Privilege & PAM Controls
Requirements.Description: Enforce strong authentication, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for remote/cloud access, Need-to-Know/Need-to-Use least privilege, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and periodic user access reviews.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-4 Periodic Review of User Identities & Access Rights
Requirements.Description: The implementation of identity and access management requirements and user access lists must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-3-1 Information Systems Protection Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting information systems and processing facilities must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-3-2 Information Systems Protection Implementation
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting information systems and processing facilities must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-3-3 Antivirus/Anti-Malware, Patching, Media & NTP Time Sync
Requirements.Description: Advanced malware protection on servers, restricted external storage media, patch management, and centralized clock synchronization (e.g. SASO NTP).

Requirements.Name: 2-3-4 Periodic Review of System Protection Controls
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting information systems and processing facilities must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-4-1 Email Protection Policy Definition
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting email services must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-4-2 Email Protection Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for email service must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-4-3 Anti-Phishing, Email MFA, Archiving, APT & SPF/DKIM Validation
Requirements.Description: Filter phishing/spam, enforce MFA for webmail/remote access, maintain secure archiving, protect against APTs, and validate domains via SPF/DKIM/DMARC.

Requirements.Name: 2-4-4 Periodic Review of Email Protection Controls
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for email service must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-1 Network Security Management Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for network security management must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-2 Network Security Management Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for network security management must be implemented across all VCNs and subnets.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-3 Network Segmentation, Firewalls, Port Restrictions & IPS/DNS Security
Requirements.Description: Enforce logical/physical segmentation using firewalls, isolate prod/dev/test, restrict internet file sharing, protect wireless with strong encryption, manage ports/protocols, deploy IPS, secure DNS, and guard against APT browsing threats.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-4 Periodic Review of Network Security Controls
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for network security management must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-6-1 Mobile Devices & BYOD Security Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for mobile devices security and BYOD must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-6-2 Mobile Devices & BYOD Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for mobile devices security and BYOD must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-6-3 Mobile Encryption, Remote Wipe, Restricted Use & User Awareness
Requirements.Description: Enforce data separation/encryption on mobile devices/BYODs, restrict use to job needs, enable remote wipe upon loss/separation, and conduct user awareness.

Requirements.Name: 2-6-4 Periodic Review of Mobile Security Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for mobile devices security and BYOD must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-1 Data and Information Protection Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting and handling data and information must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-2 Data Protection Policy Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for protecting and handling data and information must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-3 Data Ownership, Classification Labeling & Privacy
Requirements.Description: Define data ownership, implement data classification labeling mechanisms, and protect data privacy as per Saudi regulations.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-4 Periodic Review of Data Protection Controls
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for protecting and handling data and information must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-1 Cryptography Policy & Key Management Definition
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for cryptography must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-2 Cryptography Policy Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for cryptography must be implemented across all cloud storage, databases, and networks.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-3 Cryptographic Key Lifecycle Management & Encryption at Rest/In-Transit
Requirements.Description: Use approved cryptographic standards, securely manage keys throughout their lifecycle in Azure Key Vault, and enforce encryption in-transit (TLS 1.2+) and at-rest.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-4 Periodic Review of Cryptography Controls
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for cryptography must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-1 Backup and Recovery Management Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-2 Backup and Recovery Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management must be implemented across all critical systems.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-3 Backup Scope, Rapid Recovery & Periodic Recovery Effectiveness Testing
Requirements.Description: Ensure backup scope covers all critical cloud technology and data, verify rapid recovery capabilities after incidents, and conduct periodic recovery tests.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-4 Periodic Review of Backup & Recovery Controls
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-10-1 Vulnerabilities Management Policy Definition
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for technical vulnerabilities management must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-10-2 Vulnerabilities Management Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for technical vulnerabilities management must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-10-3 Periodic Scanning, Criticality Classification, Patching & Threat Feeds
Requirements.Description: Perform periodic vulnerability assessments, classify by risk criticality, remediate promptly, apply security patches, and subscribe to trusted threat vulnerability intelligence.

Requirements.Name: 2-10-4 Periodic Review of Vulnerability Management Controls
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for technical vulnerabilities management must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-11-1 Penetration Testing Policy Definition
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for penetration testing exercises must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-11-2 Penetration Testing Processes Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for penetration testing processes must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-11-3 Internet-Facing Scope & Periodic Penetration Testing
Requirements.Description: Scope must cover internet-facing infrastructure, websites, APIs, mobile apps, email, and remote access; tests must be conducted periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-11-4 Periodic Review of Penetration Testing Processes
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for penetration testing processes must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-12-1 Event Logs and Monitoring Management Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for event logs and monitoring management must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-12-2 Event Logs & Monitoring Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for event logs and monitoring management must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-12-3 SIEM Centralization, Privileged Access Logging & 12-Month Log Retention
Requirements.Description: Activate event logs on critical assets and privileged accounts, ingest into centralized SIEM for continuous monitoring, and retain logs for a minimum of 12 months (365 days).

Requirements.Name: 2-12-4 Periodic Review of Logging & Monitoring Controls
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for event logs and monitoring management must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-13-1 Incident and Threat Management Policy Definition
Requirements.Description: Requirements for cybersecurity incidents and threat management must be defined, documented, and approved (as per Royal Decree 37140).

Requirements.Name: 2-13-2 Incident and Threat Management Implementation
Requirements.Description: The requirements for cybersecurity incidents and threat management must be implemented across all operational units.

Requirements.Name: 2-13-3 Incident Response Plans, Classification, NCA Notification & Threat Feeds
Requirements.Description: Establish incident response plans, classify severity, report incidents to NCA, share indicators/threat intelligence with NCA, and collect threat feeds.

Requirements.Name: 2-13-4 Periodic Review of Incident Management Procedures
Requirements.Description: The requirements for cybersecurity incidents and threat management must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-14-1 Physical Security Policy Definition
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for physical protection of information and technology assets must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-14-2 Physical Security Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for physical protection of information and technology assets must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-14-3 Facility Access Control, CCTV, Secure Disposal & Perimeter Security
Requirements.Description: Authorized access to sensitive areas (data centers, network cabinets), entry/exit logs with CCTV monitoring, secure destruction/re-use of classified media, and perimeter security.

Requirements.Name: 2-14-4 Periodic Review of Physical Security Requirements
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for physical protection of information and technology assets must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 2-15-1 Web Application Security Policy Definition
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for external web applications must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 2-15-2 Web Application Security Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for external web applications must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 2-15-3 Web Application Firewall (WAF), Multi-Tier, HTTPS & User MFA
Requirements.Description: Deploy Web Application Firewall (WAF), adopt multi-tier architecture, enforce HTTPS/TLS protocols, clarify secure usage policies, and require MFA for user access.

Requirements.Name: 2-15-4 Periodic Review of Web Application Security
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for external web applications must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 3-1-1 Cybersecurity Resiliency in BCM Definition
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for business continuity management must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 3-1-2 BCM Resiliency Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for business continuity management must be implemented across all critical operations.

Requirements.Name: 3-1-3 Continuity of Security Systems, Incident Plans & Disaster Recovery (DR)
Requirements.Description: Ensure continuity of cybersecurity systems, develop incident response plans affecting business continuity, and maintain tested disaster recovery (DR) plans.

Requirements.Name: 3-1-4 Periodic Review of BCM Cybersecurity Requirements
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for business continuity management must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 4-1-1 Third-Party Cybersecurity Requirements in Contracts
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements for contracts and agreements with third-parties must be identified, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 4-1-2 NDA Clauses, Incident Communication & Regulatory Compliance
Requirements.Description: Third-party SLAs must include non-disclosure clauses, secure data removal upon service termination, incident communication procedures, and regulatory compliance obligations.

Requirements.Name: 4-1-3 Risk Assessment & In-Kingdom SOC/NOC Presence for Managed Services
Requirements.Description: Conduct risk assessments before outsourcing contracts, and mandate that cybersecurity managed services monitoring/operations centers (SOC/NOC) must be completely located inside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Requirements.Name: 4-1-4 Periodic Review of Third-Party Agreements
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements for contracts and agreements with third-parties must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 4-2-1 Cloud Computing & Hosting Cybersecurity Policy
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity requirements related to the use of hosting and cloud computing services must be defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 4-2-2 Cloud Cybersecurity Requirements Implementation
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements related to the use of hosting and cloud computing services must be implemented.

Requirements.Name: 4-2-3 Data Classification, Multi-Tenant Isolation & In-Kingdom Data Hosting
Requirements.Description: Classify data prior to cloud hosting, ensure virtual server tenant isolation from other environments, and mandate that organizational information hosting and storage must reside inside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Requirements.Name: 4-2-4 Periodic Review of Cloud Hosting Controls
Requirements.Description: The cybersecurity requirements related to the use of hosting and cloud computing services must be reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 5-1-1 ICS/OT Cybersecurity Requirements Definition
Requirements.Description: Define, document, and approve cybersecurity requirements for Industrial Control Systems and Operational Technology (ICS/OT).

Requirements.Name: 5-1-2 ICS/OT Cybersecurity Requirements Implementation
Requirements.Description: Implement the approved cybersecurity requirements for Industrial Control Systems and Operational Technology (ICS/OT).

Requirements.Name: 5-1-3 ICS/OT Network Segmentation, Monitoring & Patch Management
Requirements.Description: Physically/virtually segment industrial networks from corporate and external networks, continuously monitor and log ICS/OT events, isolate Safety Instrumented Systems, restrict external media and mobile device connections, and maintain vulnerability/patch management and malware protection for ICS/OT systems.

Requirements.Name: 5-1-4 Periodic Review of ICS/OT Cybersecurity Requirements
Requirements.Description: Periodically review the cybersecurity requirements related to Industrial Control Systems and Operational Technology (ICS/OT).
